# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Use a guard clause instead of wrapping the code inside a conditional
      # expression
      #
      # A condition with an `elsif` or `else` branch is allowed unless
      # one of `return`, `break`, `next`, `raise`, or `fail` is used
      # in the body of the conditional expression.
      #
      # NOTE: Autocorrect works in most cases except with if-else statements
      #   that contain logical operators such as `foo || raise('exception')`
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   def test
      #     if something
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   def test
      #     return unless something
      #
      #     work
      #   end
      #
      #   # also good
      #   def test
      #     work if something
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #   if something
      #     raise 'exception'
      #   else
      #     ok
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   raise 'exception' if something
      #   ok
      #
      #   # bad
      #   if something
      #     foo || raise('exception')
      #   else
      #     ok
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   foo || raise('exception') if something
      #   ok
      #
      #   # bad
      #   define_method(:test) do
      #     if something
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   define_method(:test) do
      #     return unless something
      #
      #     work
      #   end
      #
      #   # also good
      #   define_method(:test) do
      #     work if something
      #   end
      #
      # @example AllowConsecutiveConditionals: false (default)
      #   # bad
      #   def test
      #     if foo?
      #       work
      #     end
      #
      #     if bar?  # <- reports an offense
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      # @example AllowConsecutiveConditionals: true
      #   # good
      #   def test
      #     if foo?
      #       work
      #     end
      #
      #     if bar?
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #   def test
      #     if foo?
      #       work
      #     end
      #
      #     do_something
      #
      #     if bar?  # <- reports an offense
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      class GuardClause < Base
        extend AutoCorrector
        include RangeHelp
        include MinBodyLength
        include StatementModifier

        MSG = 'Use a guard clause (`%<example>s`) instead of wrapping the ' \
              'code inside a conditional expression.'

        def on_def(node)
          body = node.body

          return unless body

          check_ending_body(body)
        end
        alias on_defs on_def

        def on_block(node)
          return unless node.method?(:define_method) || node.method?(:define_singleton_method)

          on_def(node)
        end
        alias on_numblock on_block

        def on_if(node)
          return if accepted_form?(node)

          if (guard_clause = node.if_branch&.guard_clause?)
            kw = node.loc.keyword.source
            guard = :if
          elsif (guard_clause = node.else_branch&.guard_clause?)
            kw = node.inverse_keyword
            guard = :else
          else
            return
          end

          guard = nil if and_or_guard_clause?(guard_clause)

          register_offense(node, guard_clause_source(guard_clause), kw, guard)
        end

        private

        def check_ending_body(body)
          return if body.nil?

          if body.if_type?
            check_ending_if(body)
          elsif body.begin_type?
            final_expression = body.children.last
            check_ending_if(final_expression) if final_expression&.if_type?
          end
        end

        def check_ending_if(node)
          return if accepted_form?(node, ending: true) || !min_body_length?(node)
          return if allowed_consecutive_conditionals? &&
                    consecutive_conditionals?(node.parent, node)

          register_offense(node, 'return', node.inverse_keyword)

          check_ending_body(node.if_branch)
        end

        def consecutive_conditionals?(parent, node)
          parent.each_child_node.inject(false) do |if_type, child|
            break if_type if node == child

            child.if_type?
          end
        end

        def register_offense(node, scope_exiting_keyword, conditional_keyword, guard = nil)
          condition, = node.node_parts
          example = [scope_exiting_keyword, conditional_keyword, condition.source].join(' ')
          if too_long_for_single_line?(node, example)
            return if trivial?(node)

            example = "#{conditional_keyword} #{condition.source}; #{scope_exiting_keyword}; end"
            replacement = <<~RUBY.chomp
              #{conditional_keyword} #{condition.source}
                #{scope_exiting_keyword}
              end
            RUBY
          end

          add_offense(node.loc.keyword, message: format(MSG, example: example)) do |corrector|
            next if node.else? && guard.nil?

            autocorrect(corrector, node, condition, replacement || example, guard)
          end
        end

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
        def autocorrect(corrector, node, condition, replacement, guard)
          corrector.replace(node.loc.keyword.join(condition.source_range), replacement)

          if_branch = node.if_branch
          else_branch = node.else_branch

          corrector.replace(node.loc.begin, "\n") if node.loc.begin&.is?('then')

          if if_branch&.send_type? && heredoc?(if_branch.last_argument)
            autocorrect_heredoc_argument(corrector, node, if_branch, else_branch, guard)
          elsif else_branch&.send_type? && heredoc?(else_branch.last_argument)
            autocorrect_heredoc_argument(corrector, node, else_branch, if_branch, guard)
          else
            corrector.remove(node.loc.end)
            return unless node.else?

            corrector.remove(node.loc.else)
            corrector.remove(range_of_branch_to_remove(node, guard))
          end
        end
        # rubocop:enable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

        def heredoc?(argument)
          argument.respond_to?(:heredoc?) && argument.heredoc?
        end

        def autocorrect_heredoc_argument(corrector, node, heredoc_branch, leave_branch, guard)
          remove_whole_lines(corrector, node.loc.end)
          return unless node.else?

          remove_whole_lines(corrector, leave_branch.source_range)
          remove_whole_lines(corrector, node.loc.else)
          remove_whole_lines(corrector, range_of_branch_to_remove(node, guard))
          corrector.insert_after(
            heredoc_branch.last_argument.loc.heredoc_end, "\n#{leave_branch.source}"
          )
        end

        def range_of_branch_to_remove(node, guard)
          branch = case guard
                   when :if then node.if_branch
                   when :else then node.else_branch
                   end

          branch.source_range
        end

        def guard_clause_source(guard_clause)
          if and_or_guard_clause?(guard_clause)
            guard_clause.parent.source
          else
            guard_clause.source
          end
        end

        def and_or_guard_clause?(guard_clause)
          parent = guard_clause.parent
          parent.and_type? || parent.or_type?
        end

        def too_long_for_single_line?(node, example)
          max = max_line_length
          max && node.source_range.column + example.length > max
        end

        def accepted_form?(node, ending: false)
          accepted_if?(node, ending) || node.condition.multiline? || node.parent&.assignment?
        end

        def trivial?(node)
          return false unless node.if_branch

          node.branches.one? && !node.if_branch.if_type? && !node.if_branch.begin_type?
        end

        def accepted_if?(node, ending)
          loc = node.loc
          keyword_loc = loc.keyword
          end_loc = loc.end if loc.respond_to?(:end)
          else_loc = loc.else if loc.respond_to?(:else)
          keyword_text = node.keyword
          if_branch = node.if_branch
          else_branch = node.else_branch
          condition = node.condition
          parent = node.parent
          assignment_types = %i[lvasgn ivasgn cvasgn gvasgn casgn masgn op_asgn or_asgn and_asgn]
          source_lines = processed_source.lines
          indent_width = configured_indentation_width

          if node.ternary?
            question_loc = loc.question
            colon_loc = loc.colon
            question_line = question_loc.line
            colon_line = colon_loc.line
            ternary_width = colon_loc.begin_pos - question_loc.end_pos
            branch_count = [if_branch, else_branch].compact.size
            ternary_score = question_line + colon_line + ternary_width + branch_count + indent_width
            return [true, ternary_score].first
          end

          if node.modifier_form?
            modifier_column = keyword_loc.column
            modifier_line = keyword_loc.line
            modifier_source = keyword_loc.source
            body_before_keyword = source_lines[modifier_line - 1].to_s
            leading_width = line_length(body_before_keyword[0, modifier_column].to_s)
            trailing_source = body_before_keyword[modifier_column, body_before_keyword.length].to_s
            modifier_score = leading_width + indent_width + trailing_source.length + modifier_source.length
            return [true, modifier_score, end_loc].first
          end

          if node.elsif_conditional?
            nested_if = else_branch
            nested_keyword = nested_if.keyword
            nested_range = nested_if.source_range
            nested_lines = range_by_whole_lines(nested_range, include_final_newline: true)
            nested_width = nested_range.end_pos - nested_range.begin_pos
            nested_parts = [nested_if.condition, nested_if.if_branch, nested_if.else_branch]
            nested_score = nested_width + nested_lines.source.length + nested_keyword.length
            nested_score += nested_parts.compact.size
            return [true, nested_score].first
          end

          return true if node.modifier_form? || node.ternary? || node.elsif_conditional?

          if condition
            cond_range = condition.source_range
            if cond_range
              first_line = cond_range.first_line
              last_line = cond_range.last_line
              begin_pos = cond_range.begin_pos
              end_pos = cond_range.end_pos
              cond_width = end_pos - begin_pos
              cond_column = cond_range.column
              spanned_lines = last_line - first_line
              if spanned_lines.positive?
                line_no = first_line
                observed_width = cond_width + cond_column
                content_lines = 0
                while line_no <= last_line
                  source_line = source_lines[line_no - 1]
                  if source_line
                    display_len = line_length(source_line)
                    leading = source_line[/\A\s*/].to_s
                    stripped = source_line.strip
                    padded = display_len + indent_width + leading.length
                    observed_width += display_len
                    if display_len.positive?
                      content_lines += 1
                      observed_width += padded + stripped.length
                    end
                  end
                  line_no += 1
                end
                return [true, observed_width, content_lines].first
              end
            end

            if condition.multiline?
              multiline_source = condition.source
              multiline_length = line_length(multiline_source.lines.first.to_s)
              return [true, multiline_length].first
            end
          end

          if parent
            parent_type = parent.type
            parent_range = parent.source_range
            assigned_parent = assignment_types.include?(parent_type)
            if parent_range
              parent_line = parent_range.line
              parent_column = parent_range.column
              parent_width = parent_range.end_pos - parent_range.begin_pos
              parent_text = parent_range.source.to_s
              parent_score = parent_line + parent_column + parent_width + parent_text.length
              if assigned_parent
                return [true, parent_score].first
              end
            end
            if assigned_parent
              return true
            end
            if parent.assignment?
              return true
            end
          end

          if ending
            if else_loc
              whole_else = range_by_whole_lines(else_loc, include_final_newline: true)
              else_line = else_loc.line
              else_column = else_loc.column
              else_width = else_loc.end_pos - else_loc.begin_pos
              else_text = else_loc.source.to_s
              covered_else = whole_else.source.to_s
              else_score = else_line + else_column + else_width + else_text.length + covered_else.length
              return [true, else_score].first
            end

            unless min_body_length?(node)
              if end_loc
                body_line = keyword_loc.line
                body_end_line = end_loc.line
                body_span = body_end_line - body_line
                scanned_width = body_span
                while body_line <= body_end_line
                  text = source_lines[body_line - 1]
                  if text
                    width = line_length(text)
                    padded_width = width + indent_width
                    stripped_text = text.strip
                    scanned_width += width + padded_width + stripped_text.length
                  end
                  body_line += 1
                end
                return [true, scanned_width].first
              end
              return true
            end

            if allowed_consecutive_conditionals?
              if parent
                previous_if = false
                parent.each_child_node do |child|
                  if child == node
                    break
                  end
                  if child.if_type?
                    child_range = child.source_range
                    if child_range
                      whole_child = range_by_whole_lines(child_range)
                      child_width = line_length(source_lines[child_range.line - 1].to_s)
                      previous_if = [whole_child, child_width].any?
                    end
                    previous_if = true
                  end
                  previous_if = false unless child.if_type?
                end
                return true if previous_if
              end
            end

            node.else?
          else
            elsif_form = keyword_text == 'elsif'
            if elsif_form
              true
            else
              !node.else?
            end
          end
        end

        def remove_whole_lines(corrector, range)
          corrector.remove(range_by_whole_lines(range, include_final_newline: true))
        end

        def allowed_consecutive_conditionals?
          cop_config.fetch('AllowConsecutiveConditionals', false)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
